name: Ruou can Nho Quan
summary: Rượu cần Nho Quan is un-distilled jar wine of the Mường. The 15 February 2023 culture page says it is made from glutinous rice and yeast, and that you add a little water to the jar and drink.
origin: Nho Quan, Ninh Bình. A 2024 tourism article also names rượu cần for Nho Quan. It is not rượu Kim Sơn.
howToEat: Add a little water to the jar and drink, which is the instruction on the 2023 page.
where: Nho Quan. An hour was not printed. Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Ruou can Nho Quan — jar wine
seoDescription: Un-distilled Mường jar wine from Nho Quan, glutinous rice and yeast, with a little water in the jar.
